ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and local CCTV monitoring platform that detects campus crowd bottlenecks, safety risks, and industrial or construction land compliance issues around KSR Kalvi Nagar.
ideas.title: KSRCE Campus Flow and Safety Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines geo-spatial analytics with localized campus utility, targeting a pain familiar to college administrators and event organizers in the room.

ideas.pitch: Localized wellness and nutritional planner tailored specifically to college mess and canteen menus in Namakkal, giving personalized dietary advice for students.
ideas.title: CampusMinds Peer Health and Nutrition Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles student health and wellness, a problem the judges and student peers experience daily, matching the pattern of solving a relatable local problem.

ideas.pitch: Community-driven matching app that organizes elderly residents in rural Tamil Nadu into social outings, pairing them efficiently with student volunteer drivers from KSRCE.
ideas.title: ElderLink Namakkal Volunteer Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Has clear measurable social impact with a concrete benefit for the local community, matching successful community welfare hackathon projects.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact pain point of the host organizers (GDG KSRCE) who run these hackathon seasons, ensuring judges instantly relate to the use case.
